Bay Area Roofing Done Right

Why Homeowners & Businesses Trust ROOF EXPRESS

When it comes to protecting your property in the San Francisco Bay Area, your roof is one of the most important investments you can make. From heavy winter rain in San Francisco to intense summer heat in San Jose and the Peninsula, Bay Area roofs face unique challenges year-round. That’s why property owners across the region continue to trust ROOF EXPRESS for premium residential and commercial roofing solutions built to last.

At ROOF EXPRESS, we believe roofing is more than just shingles and materials — it’s about protecting families, businesses, and investments with quality craftsmanship, honest service, and long-term reliability. Our experienced roofing professionals proudly serve San Francisco, Oakland, San Mateo, Palo Alto, Fremont, Hayward, Walnut Creek, Berkeley, Concord, Marin County, and surrounding Bay Area cities with expert roofing installation, replacement, repair, and maintenance services.

Premium Roofing Solutions for the Bay Area

The Bay Area climate creates unique roofing conditions that require experience and proper material selection. Coastal moisture, fog, strong UV exposure, and changing temperatures can quickly damage low-quality roofing systems. ROOF EXPRESS specializes in roofing systems specifically designed for Bay Area homes and commercial buildings.

Our team installs and services:

Asphalt shingle roofing

Flat and low-slope roofing systems

Torch-down modified bitumen roofs

TPO roofing systems

Commercial roofing systems

Residential roof replacements

Roof leak repairs

Gutter and drainage systems

Skylight installation and replacement

Roof inspections and maintenance

Whether you own a modern home in Palo Alto, a Victorian property in San Francisco, or a commercial building in Oakland, our roofing experts provide customized solutions designed for your property type and local weather conditions.

Residential Roofing Services Built to Protect Your Home

Your home deserves a roofing system that not only looks beautiful but also delivers long-term protection and energy efficiency. ROOF EXPRESS works with industry-leading roofing manufacturers and premium materials to ensure every residential roofing project meets the highest standards of durability and performance.

Our residential roofing services include complete roof replacement, new roof installation, leak repair, flashing repair, ventilation upgrades, skylight work, and preventative roof maintenance. We help homeowners choose the right roofing materials, colors, and systems that match both their architectural style and budget.

Many Bay Area homeowners choose architectural asphalt shingles because they provide excellent weather resistance, attractive curb appeal, and strong manufacturer warranties. We proudly install premium roofing products from trusted manufacturers including GAF, CertainTeed, and Owens Corning.

Commercial Roofing Experts Across the Bay Area

Commercial roofing requires specialized knowledge, safety protocols, and long-term performance planning. ROOF EXPRESS provides professional commercial roofing services for apartment buildings, retail properties, office buildings, warehouses, HOA communities, and mixed-use properties throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

Our commercial roofing systems are designed for durability, drainage performance, energy efficiency, and minimal maintenance. We understand how important it is for businesses to avoid disruptions, which is why our team works efficiently while maintaining clean and organized job sites.

We specialize in:

Flat roof replacement

Torch-down roofing systems

TPO commercial roofing

Roof coating systems

Leak detection and waterproofing

Preventative maintenance programs

Drainage and gutter improvements

Why Bay Area Property Owners Choose ROOF EXPRESS

ROOF EXPRESS has built a reputation for quality workmanship, reliable communication, and professional service throughout the Bay Area. Our customers value transparency, attention to detail, and roofing systems built for long-term performance.

What sets us apart:

Diamond Certified Quality

We proudly maintain high standards of workmanship and customer satisfaction with a strong focus on professionalism and reliability.

GAF Certified Roofing Contractor

As a GAF Certified contractor, we install roofing systems according to strict manufacturer standards to help ensure quality and warranty protection.

Free Roofing Estimates

We provide honest, detailed roofing estimates with clear recommendations and no pressure sales tactics.

Local Bay Area Experience

Our team understands the unique roofing challenges of San Francisco and surrounding Bay Area cities. From coastal moisture to hillside properties and flat roof systems, we know what works best locally.

Professional Craftsmanship

Every roofing project is completed with careful attention to installation details, waterproofing, ventilation, flashing, and long-term performance.

Roofing Designed for San Francisco Weather

San Francisco roofs experience heavy moisture exposure from fog, rain, salt air, and changing temperatures. Without proper installation and drainage, roofs can develop leaks, ponding water, mold, and structural damage over time.

ROOF EXPRESS focuses on proper waterproofing, high-quality underlayment systems, flashing protection, and drainage design to help roofs perform efficiently throughout the year. Our team carefully evaluates every roof structure to identify potential weak points before they become expensive problems.

Serving the Greater Bay Area

ROOF EXPRESS proudly serves:

San Francisco

Oakland

San Mateo

Palo Alto

Berkeley

Hayward

Fremont

Walnut Creek

Concord

Marin County

South San Francisco

Daly City

Redwood City

San Jose

And surrounding Bay Area communities

No matter the size of the project, our goal remains the same: deliver premium roofing solutions built to protect what matters most.

Schedule Your Free Roofing Estimate Today

If you are looking for trusted residential or commercial roofing experts in the San Francisco Bay Area, ROOF EXPRESS is ready to help. Whether you need a complete roof replacement, emergency leak repair, flat roofing installation, or preventative maintenance, our experienced team is committed to delivering quality results with professionalism and care.

Contact ROOF EXPRESS today to schedule your free roofing estimate and discover why Bay Area homeowners and businesses continue to trust our team for reliable roofing solutions.
